title: Carrier Pickup Event Fields
description: Fields and event types for a parcel sent to a carrier point. Deposit at the point and collection by the recipient are separate events. Events of a parcel are ordered by `occurred_at`, not by array or arrival order.

type.description: Event types this extension defines for parcels sent to a carrier point: `deposited_at_point` (the carrier reports the parcel placed at the point; the holding period runs from the event its `pickup_period.starts` names, deposit or notification), `pickup_deadline_changed` (the carrier reports a new deadline at the same point, for example an extension, without a new deposit), `collected_at_point` (the carrier reports the parcel collected), `pickup_expired` (the holding period ended without collection), `returning_to_sender` (the parcel is on its way back to the Business). The core `returned_to_sender` keeps its core meaning (back at the Business).

parcel_id.description: Business-scoped identifier of the parcel, stable across all events of that parcel, including redirects and extensions. Required on the carrier pickup event types. Distinct from `tracking_number`, which a carrier may reuse or replace.

point.description: The carrier point where the parcel is, or was, waiting. Required on `deposited_at_point`, `collected_at_point` and `pickup_expired`.

pickup_by.description: RFC 3339 timestamp until which the parcel waits at `point`, as reported by the carrier. Required on `deposited_at_point` and `pickup_deadline_changed`; `null` means the Business does not know the deadline, and the Platform MUST NOT compute one. The latest of these events for the same `parcel_id` gives the current deadline.

corrects.description: `id` of an earlier event of the same Order that this event corrects. The earlier event stays in the log but no longer counts; this event states what happened instead. A correction of a `collected_at_point` reopens the parcel's state.

description.description: Plain text, no markup or links.
